Stock Market Volatility Hits Indian Banks

The Indian stock market experienced significant volatility on [date] with major banks like HDFC Bank and Axis Bank facing heavy selling pressure. The Sensex index declined by 443 points, largely due to the decline of these two banks. Analysts have cut their estimates for Axis Bank after its Q1 earnings report, leading to a 5% fall in its stock price. Meanwhile, other banks such as ICICI Bank and RIL also saw significant movements in their stock prices. The market's reaction to these developments is being closely watched by investors.
